findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: html_markdown, image_ocr, audio_memo, audio_meeting, url_metadata · Private data: pdf_merge, doc_markdown, image_ocr, audio_memo, text_chunk, pdf_images, text_tokens · Public sink: pdf_markdown, pdf_text, pdf_info, pdf_split, pdf_merge, doc_markdown, docx_markdown, html_markdown, sheet_json, image_ocr, markdown_pdf, audio_transcribe, audio_memo, audio_meeting, url_metadata, text_chunk, json_validate, pdf_images, text_tokens, audio_transcribe_long · Destructive: pdf_split, pdf_merge, markdown_pdf, pdf_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: html_markdown, image_ocr, audio_memo, audio_meeting, url_metadata · Private data: pdf_merge, doc_markdown, image_ocr, audio_memo, text_chunk, pdf_images, text_tokens · Public sink: pdf_markdown, pdf_text, pdf_info, pdf_split, pdf_merge, doc_markdown, docx_markdown, html_markdown, sheet_json, image_ocr, markdown_pdf, audio_transcribe, audio_memo, audio_meeting, url_metadata, text_chunk, json_validate, pdf_images, text_tokens, audio_transcribe_long · Destructive: pdf_split, pdf_merge, markdown_pdf, pdf_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
